# Roboterrium overview

## An experimental infrastructure for agricultural robotics {.infrastructure-slide}

<!-- ::: {.columns} -->
::: {.column width="55%"}
Roboterrium is an INRAE experimental infrastructure dedicated to the study of robotic systems in agricultural environments.

::: {.highlight-box}
Design, integrate and evaluate robotic solutions for the agroecological transition.
:::

:::

::: {.column width="45%"}
![](img/01_roboterrium_overview/roboterrium_flotte.jpg){fig-align="center" width="100%"}

<!-- - Modelling and simulation
- Robotic platform integration
- Field experiments at Montoldre
- Shared infrastructure within EquipEx+ TIRREX -->

:::
<!-- ::: -->

## Research challenges

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="45%"}
::: {.highlight-box .theme-box}

::: {.theme-items}

- Identify the technical barriers limiting the use of robots in agriculture
- Design, integrate and validate solutions in controlled conditions and then in the field
- Assess robustness, safety, autonomy and acceptability
- Pool resources, capitalize on results and promote reproducibility

:::
:::
:::

::: {.column width="55%"}
::: {.research-themes}
::: {.research-theme .theme-green}
**Adaptive robot behaviour**

Path and task planning · Unstructured environment control · Robust localization and 3D mapping · Environment adaptation · Advanced navigation · Perception and decision-making
:::

::: {.research-theme .theme-red}
**Safety and robustness**

Degraded-environment perception · Validation and qualification · Traversability analysis · Functional safety · Rollover prevention · Standards
:::

::: {.research-theme .theme-blue}
**Robot and human interaction**

Robot fleet coordination · Human cooperation · Robot cooperation · Acceptability · Shared autonomy · Remote supervision
:::

::: {.research-theme .theme-orange}
**Plants, soils and cropping systems**

Plant and soil perception · Robotic cropping systems · Robotic agricultural operations · Agroecological practices · Physical interaction · Environmental impact
:::

:::
:::
:::

::: {.project-strip}
**Projects:** TIRREX · Grand Défi Robotique Agricole · PEPR Agroécologie & Numérique · national, European and international collaborations
:::


## INRAE Montoldre site

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
An INRAE site of approximately **100 hectares** dedicated to agricultural robotics experiments.

::: {.highlight-box .compact-bullets}
- Arable crop fields
- Forest areas
- Pond
- Test tracks
- Operational conditions
- <span class="nowrap">Agrotechnopole facilities</span>
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
![](img/01_roboterrium_overview/montoldre_site.png){fig-align="center" width="100%"}
:::
:::


## The Agrotechnopole {.terrain-slide}

![](img/01_roboterrium_overview/terrains_controllés.png){fig-align="center" .terrain-image}

::: {.highlight-box .terrain-points}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="33%"}
### Repeat
Controlled fields and test benches for comparing and reproducing experiments.
:::

::: {.column width="33%"}
### Challenge
Controlled slopes, soils and obstacles for testing robot limits.
:::

::: {.column width="33%"}
### Secure
An enclosed robotic area for long-duration experiments without human presence.
:::
:::
:::

## Shared robotic fleet

::: {.platform-frame}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="42%"}
Roboterrium brings together a shared fleet of robotic platforms provided by several research organizations.

::: {.highlight-box .compact-bullets}
- Platforms from INRAE, CNRS, CEA and partners
- Agricultural and off-road locomotion systems
- Onboard sensors for perception, state estimation and control
- Robots able to carry or operate agricultural implements
:::
:::

## Open-source software ecosystem

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="35%"}
::: {.software-forge-intro}
Roboterrium relies on a structured software forge<br> to share, sustain and disseminate the components required for agricultural robotics experiments.
:::

::: {.forge-links}
**GitHub:** [ROMEA](https://github.com/Romea) · [TIRREX-Roboterrium](https://github.com/Tirrex-Roboterrium)
:::
:::

::: {.column width="65%"}
![](img/01_roboterrium_overview/environnement_logiciel.png){fig-align="center" width="100%"}
:::
:::

::: {.highlight-box .software-forge-points}
::: {.software-forge-five}
::: {.software-forge-item}
**ROS 2 foundation**

Modular and interoperable robotic systems
:::

::: {.software-forge-item}
**Unified integration**

Robots, GNSS, IMUs, lidars and cameras
:::

::: {.software-forge-item}
**Reusable capabilities**

Perception, localisation, navigation and autonomous missions
:::

::: {.software-forge-item}
**Reproducible deployment**

Portable Docker environments
:::

::: {.software-forge-item}
**Open source**

Reusable for research, industry and training
:::
:::
:::

## Simulation environments

::: {.columns .simulation-overview}
::: {.column width="52%"}

::: {.simulation-image-title}
INRAE Montoldre simulation environment
:::

![](img/01_roboterrium_overview/simulation/montoldre_simulation.png){.simulation-image fig-align="center" width="100%"}

::: {.simulation-image-title}
Roboterrium robots
:::

![](img/01_roboterrium_overview/simulation/robots_simulation.png){.simulation-image .simulation-image-bottom fig-align="center" width="100%"}

:::

::: {.column width="48%"}
Simulation is used to prepare, test and validate robotic missions before field deployment, while maintaining continuity with real platforms and experiments.

::: {.simulation-tool}
**Gazebo**

Rapid prototyping of robotic architectures and missions in simplified environments.
:::

::: {.simulation-tool}
**NVIDIA Isaac Sim**

Detailed camera and lidar modelling for perception algorithms and synthetic data generation.
:::

::: {.simulation-tool}
**4D Virtualiz**

Degraded weather and lighting conditions, real-time simulation and Hardware-in-the-Loop validation.
:::

:::
:::
